::: {#def-saturated-model}

#### Saturated model (full model, maximal model)

The **saturated model**
[@wikipedia_saturated_model] (also called the **full model** [@dobson4e, Section 5.5] or **maximal model** [@dobson4e, Section 5.5]) for binary outcomes gives each pattern its own free event probability:

$$
\Prf{\Outvar_\iobs = 1 \mid \vpredvar_\iobs = \vpredvar^{(k)}} = \prob_k,
\qquad k = 1, \dots, \npatterns,
$$ {#eq-saturated-model}

with the outcomes independent given the predictors.

:::
